# InterContinental Tokyo Bay

> Luxury waterfront hotel in Tokyo featuring award-winning dining, Rainbow Bridge views, and 330 guest rooms near Takeshiba Station.

InterContinental Tokyo Bay is a premium hospitality destination offering fine dining experiences including MANHATTAN champagne bar and TAKUMI teppanyaki, Club Lounge access, and comprehensive meeting and event facilities. The hotel is part of the IHG One Rewards program and has been recognized by World Luxury Awards 2025.

## Hotel Overview

- [InterContinental Tokyo Bay](https://www.interconti-tokyo.com/en/): Homepage for InterContinental Tokyo Bay luxury hotel near Takeshiba Station
- [Accommodation](https://www.interconti-tokyo.com/en/stay/): Hotel accommodations: 330 rooms, 6 floor types, IHG One Rewards program

## Fine Dining & Restaurants

- [Rainbow Bridge View Dining & Champagne Bar MANHATTAN](https://www.interconti-tokyo.com/en/manhattan/): MANHATTAN restaurant: N.Y. grilled French cuisine with Rainbow Bridge views
- [Teppan-Yaki TAKUMI](https://www.interconti-tokyo.com/en/takumi/): TAKUMI teppanyaki restaurant featuring award-winning Miyazaki beef cuisine
